data_sources.name: nasa_modis
data_sources.label: NASA MODIS (Terra/Aqua)
data_sources.producer_institution: NASA EOSDIS; LP DAAC and LAADS DAAC
data_sources.description: Product-specific MODIS Collection 6.1 profiles. MOD prefix denotes Terra; MCD combines Terra and Aqua. Public metadata is open; protected data downloads require Earthdata credentials. NASA unrestricted use statement is not converted to an unsupported SPDX identifier. Cite each product DOI. VIIRS products accepted by the same R adapter are outside this MODIS source. MOD13A2 is registered using the multi_day enum extension and a verified inverse decoder; the legacy R processors retain raw values by design. [Resource reconciliation: inventory rights and history] Inventory usage/citation statement (Amadeus data sources!I8): No restrictions (NASA EOSDIS); cite product DOI; Earthdata login required. Inventory source status (H8): Active (Terra/Aqua extended mission); this is not observation QA, API availability or verified support for every product. Inventory first-release/history wording (J8): 2000. 2000 is family history, not the start date of every MODIS product/version. Product dates come from NASA CMR where available. DOI-specific citations are supplied on the actual product records, not as a single family citation.
data_sources.auth_mechanism: NASA Earthdata Login / bearer token for protected data downloads; public metadata needs no token

products.name: mod11a1_061_1km
products.label: MOD11A1.061 1km native delivery
products.description: Native HDF-EOS Collection 6.1. Separate resolution groups reuse one DOI; they are profiles of the same delivery, not new NASA products. Daily files retain observation times/orbits and are not automatically daily means or complete cloud-free coverage. Tile origins depend on h/v; global array dimensions are not copied from a sample tile. Header coordinate rounding differs by less than 0.0001 m across inspected collections. AMADEUS:100002 is an explicitly registered project-local CRS label for the exact sphere/projection, not an EPSG code or database SRID. Only the stated bands are registered; full native inventories remain in evidence. MOD11/MOD09 sample archive ranges are UTC-midnight to 23:59:59; this archive-day convention does not convert MOD11 local-solar viewing hours into UTC. MAIAC preserves per-orbit acquisition intervals with observation-dependent support. The existing processor defaults select science bands only; explicit custom_sel is required for the registered QA/ancillary bands and resolution groups. NASA CMR collection identifier C1748058432-LPCLOUD; this is not a STAC identifier. [Resource reconciliation: inventory completeness] Inventory coverage statement (Amadeus data sources!N8): Yes (global; cloud/swath gaps). This statement does not establish validity of every cell/date or fill observation gaps.
products.spatial_extent_descriptor: Global MODIS tiled coverage; QA, clouds, land/ocean and retrieval masks apply
products.native_spatial_resolution_descriptor: Nominal 1km; exact sinusoidal spacing in GridDefinition
products.citation_apa: Wan, Zhengming, Simon Hook, and Glynn Hulley. 2021. “MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity Daily L3 Global 1km SIN Grid V061.” NASA EOSDIS Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/MODIS/MOD11A1.061.

products.name: mod06_l2_061_swath5km
products.label: MOD06_L2.061 swath5km native delivery
products.description: Native HDF-EOS Collection 6.1. Separate resolution groups reuse one DOI; they are profiles of the same delivery, not new NASA products. Daily files retain observation times/orbits and are not automatically daily means or complete cloud-free coverage. Tile origins depend on h/v; global array dimensions are not copied from a sample tile. Header coordinate rounding differs by less than 0.0001 m across inspected collections. AMADEUS:100002 is an explicitly registered project-local CRS label for the exact sphere/projection, not an EPSG code or database SRID. Only the stated bands are registered; full native inventories remain in evidence. MOD06 is an irregular geolocated swath; existing support=other is deliberate. No affine GridDefinition or fixed CRS/SRID is asserted. Use per-pixel geolocation. Five-minute granule duration is not a daily averaging window. Scope: five 5-km cloud-top/fraction/phase bands, not every swath retrieval. [Resource reconciliation: inventory completeness] Inventory coverage statement (Amadeus data sources!N8): Yes (global; cloud/swath gaps). products.name: mod13a2_061_1km
products.label: MOD13A2.061 vegetation indices 16-day 1km
products.description: Collection 6.1 nominal 16-day composite, not a mean of 16 daily index values. NASA MOD13 guide section 6/Table 8 supplies decoder multipliers. Native HDF scale_factor is its reciprocal for VI/reflectance/angles; preserve the attribute and divide. Read actual RANGEBEGINNING/ENDINGDATE/TIME from every granule, including year-end cycles; never synthesize all bounds from P16D. Composite day of year is a selected-pixel acquisition-day label, not Julian calendar time. Default R selection loads NDVI only and returns raw values; explicitly select other bands and decode once before physical calculations. QA policies require an explicit analysis choice; category/QA values are never averaged. [Resource reconciliation: inventory completeness] Inventory coverage statement (Amadeus data sources!N8): Yes (global; cloud/swath gaps). This statement does not establish validity of every cell/date or fill observation gaps.
